title: Baby-G Unisex Digital Watch BGD-10-1DR
description: The square BABY-G look you love in a monochromatic color scheme you’ll adore — a whimsical digital watch to boost your active life and unique style. Press the Light button in Timekeeping Mode for a random series of pixel-art animations (s urfer, dancer, dolphin, blowfish, dog, cat) that add a bit of playful fun. More than just a charming fashion statement, the BGD-10 also delivers shock-resistant construction, 100-meter water resistance, and plenty of handy functions.
